reference.pathophysiology: Calf cramp relieved by rest with ABPI under 0.9 names claudication for supervised exercise and risk control while rest pain, ulcer or gangrene names CLTI for WIfI grading with vein bypass favoured where conduit suits. One-off ultrasound screens older smoking men with five-point-five centimetres triggering AAA repair, stents for frail and open for fit. Sudden pale pulseless pain grades Rutherford for heparin with Fogarty or lysis, and seventy-percent symptomatic carotid narrowings earn fortnight endarterectomy.

EVAR versus open by age fitness and neck
Embolic versus NOMI versus chronic mesenteric by rhythm and meals
Raynaud versus Buerger versus TOS by colour age and arm
